top_choice_rationale: Heterobifunctional PROTAC degraders turn a biological process into a designable chemical event, and the molecule-making (ligand and linker design, Ciulli's drug-like VHL ligands, ternary-complex optimisation) is what made the concept general and reproducible across many laboratories. Crews, Deshaies and Ciulli give a clean, single-discovery citation. P001 is a close second because Handa's cereblon work is real and mechanistically important, but it merges two partly distinct discoveries into one citation and omits Ciulli's chemistry. Ionizable lipid nanoparticles (P003) are mature but rest largely on empirical screening and overlap with the 2023 Medicine prize, so I rank them above no award but below the degrader proposals.
